scope: One demanding workflow case study, not a universal market ranking
competitor: Runway Agent with its documented built-in model routing and timeline
beast_condition: Design Beast at cc28b346002293f46ba41ec20aa0364238035c8d, agent-operated documented tools; log all orchestration and manual work
reference_role: Shared original product-design reference, not a generated campaign output

reference_specs.product: Cobalt-blue cylindrical ceramic tea canister, copper slip-on lid, cream rectangular label
reference_specs.mark: single small copper crescent below the label text
reference_specs.geometry: approximately 120 mm tall and 80 mm in diameter

shots.scene: Moody kitchen at blue hour, closed canister on dark stone, slow dolly toward label
Same kitchen and closed canister, macro rack focus from copper lid edge to cream label
Warmly lit cafe table, hand lifts the same copper lid without changing the vessel, label remains on front
Same cafe, hand pours tea from a separate teapot into a cup; intact canister beside cup; plausible hand contact and tea flow
Moonlit terrace, closed canister beside steaming cup; 30-degree clockwise camera orbit; identity preserved
Stable hero on terrace, front label legible, tasteful end-card typography in negative space

narration: When the day gets loud, make room for quiet. NORA Night Tea. Your evening, unhurried.
audio: Original restrained instrumental bed; lid-lift and pour foley aligned within 200 ms; voice clearly intelligible

revision.reveal_after: Both original exports have been retained and hashed
revision.request: Change only shot 3 from warm amber cafe lighting to cool blue evening lighting, keeping its camera, hand action, canister geometry and label. Replace the end-card CTA with YOUR EVENING, UNHURRIED. Preserve all other shots, shot timings, narration and music. Export both aspect ratios again.

limits_per_arm.counting: Count all generated candidates, discarded media, failed billed jobs and revisions; normalize multi-shot batches by generated duration, not request count
limits_per_arm.spend_state: Paid execution prohibited until owner budget is recorded in an execution manifest

hard_gates: All four exports exist, decode fully, have the declared dimensions, fps, duration and audible audio
All six requested narrative actions are present; no still-image slideshow substituted for generated physical action
Product geometry, blue body, copper lid, cream label and crescent persist across shots
NORA and NIGHT TEA are legible and correct in hero shots 1 and 6; CTA and narration match exactly
Revision changes only specified content; compare unchanged source/timeline assets and decoded segments rather than requiring identical compressed bytes
Declared time, generated-media and approved money limits are respected; full attempts retained
rating: At least three independent humans including the owner, randomized unlabeled pairs; each dimension 1-5 with reason; report all raters and agreement. Local judge is diagnostic only, never final authority.
fairness: Identical reference.png bytes, initial brief and revision for both arms
Allow each system's documented tool ecosystem; log model identifiers, seeds where available, prompts, retries, elapsed time, cost and human intervention
No new product features or unplanned rescue tools during a scored run; repaired runs get separate identities
No competitor score from marketing claims. No creative score when output is absent. No winner without both completed arms and independent ratings
